statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server can send TEARDOWN requests in the server-to-client direction to indicate that the server has been forced to terminate the ongoing session.
actions: server sends TEARDOWN request with Terminate-Reason header

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When an RTSP client has maintained an RTSP session that otherwise is inactive for an extended period of time, the server may reclaim the resources by issuing a TEARDOWN request with the Terminate-Reason set to 'Session-Timeout'.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: In case the server needs to stop providing service to the established sessions and there is no server to point at in a REDIRECT request, then TEARDOWN SHALL be used to terminate the session.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: This method can also be used when non-recoverable internal errors have happened and the server has no other option than to terminate the sessions.
actions: server sends TEARDOWN to terminate session

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The TEARDOWN request MUST be made only on the session aggregate control URI and it MUST include the following headers: Session and Terminate-Reason.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The TEARDOWN request MUST include the following headers: Session and Terminate-Reason.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The TEARDOWN request may alternatively be done on the wildcard URI '*' and without any session header. This request indicates that all sessions and pending requests being managed via the connection are terminated.
statements.trigger: server sends TEARDOWN on wildcard URI
actions: terminate all pending requests on connection

statements.subject: participant
statements.description: Any intervening proxies SHOULD do all of the following in the order listed: 1. respond to the TEARDOWN request, 2. disconnect the control channel from the requesting server, 3. pass the TEARDOWN request to each applicable client.
statements.trigger: proxy receives wildcard TEARDOWN from server
actions: proxy sends TEARDOWN response to server
proxy disconnects control channel from requesting server
proxy passes TEARDOWN to each applicable client
